words.definition: adj. 宇宙的；外层空间的；巨大无比的

examples.en: Cosmic rays from distant stars constantly bombard the Earth's atmosphere.
examples.zh: 来自遥远恒星的宇宙射线不断轰击地球大气层。

examples.en: The two nations were locked in a cosmic struggle for influence.
examples.zh: 两国陷入了一场争夺影响力的宏大较量。

words.usage: cosmic rays 宇宙射线、cosmic dust 宇宙尘埃；引申极大的：a matter of cosmic importance 天大的事；派生 cosmos n. 宇宙
collocations: cosmic rays 宇宙射线
cosmic dust 宇宙尘埃
cosmic scale 宇宙尺度
words.mnemonic: cosm 宇宙+ic → 宇宙的；宇宙大得没边

words.definition: n. 刹车；制动器；v. 刹车；制止

examples.en: The driver braked sharply to avoid a stray dog on the highway.
examples.zh: 司机猛踩刹车，避开了高速路上的流浪狗。

examples.en: The central bank put a brake on reckless lending.
examples.zh: 央行给鲁莽放贷踩了刹车。

words.usage: 踩刹车 apply/put on the brakes，名词常用复数；put a brake on sth 遏制某事；handbrake 手刹；与 break 打破同音
collocations: put on the brakes 踩刹车
put a brake on sth 遏制某事
brake sharply 猛踩刹车
words.mnemonic: brake 谐音「别克」→ 别克急刹 → 刹车

words.definition: vt. 抢劫；盗取（银行等）；剥夺；使丧失

examples.en: The gang robbed a bank in broad daylight and fled the city.
examples.zh: 该团伙光天化日之下抢劫银行后逃出城去。

examples.en: The scandal robbed the senator of any chance of re-election.
examples.zh: 丑闻使这位参议员彻底失去了连任的机会。

words.usage: 关键句型 rob sb/sth of sth 抢走、剥夺；宾语是被抢的人或场所而非物（物用 steal）；派生 robber n. 抢劫者；robbery n. 抢劫案
collocations: rob a bank 抢银行
rob sb of sth 剥夺某人某物
get robbed 遭抢劫
words.mnemonic: rob 谐音「抢伯」→ 抢了老伯 → 抢劫

words.definition: v. （鸟、飞行器）盘旋；徘徊；踌躇；（数值）波动

examples.en: A helicopter hovered overhead, filming the marathon from the air.
examples.zh: 一架直升机在头顶盘旋，从空中拍摄马拉松。

examples.en: The patient's temperature hovered around 39 degrees all night.
examples.zh: 病人的体温整夜在39度上下徘徊。

words.usage: hover over/around 在…上方盘旋、徘徊；hover between A and B 犹豫不定；数值 hover around 上下波动为高频引申义；派生 hovering adj.
collocations: hover over the city 在城市上空盘旋
hover around 上下波动
hover between 犹豫不决
words.mnemonic: hover 谐音「候鸟」→ 候鸟盘旋等候 → 盘旋

words.definition: n. 木材（美）；旧家具（英）；v. 笨拙地挪动

examples.en: The timber yard stores vast quantities of lumber for the housing market.
examples.zh: 木材场为住房市场储备了大量木材。

examples.en: An old truck lumbered slowly up the winding mountain road.
examples.zh: 一辆旧卡车吭哧吭哧地沿蜿蜒山路缓慢爬坡。

words.usage: 英美差异：美式 lumber 等于英式 timber 木材；英式 lumber 多指旧家具杂物；习语 be lumbered with sth 被…拖累（英式）；派生 lumbering n. 伐木业
collocations: lumber industry 木材业
be lumbered with 被…拖累
lumber along 笨重地行进
words.mnemonic: lumber 谐音「狼爬」→ 笨重地慢慢爬 → 挪动

words.definition: v. 侵入；侵略；大量涌入；侵犯（权利）

examples.en: Enemy troops invaded the border region at dawn.
examples.zh: 敌军于黎明时分侵入边境地区。

examples.en: Constant phone calls invaded her privacy and disrupted her work.
examples.zh: 不断打来的电话侵犯了她的隐私，也扰乱了工作。

words.usage: invade a country 侵略国家；invade one's privacy 侵犯隐私为高频引申；派生 invader n. 入侵者；invasion n. 入侵；invasive adj. 侵入的
collocations: invade one's privacy 侵犯隐私
invade a country 入侵国家
an invading army 入侵军队
words.mnemonic: in 进+vade（走）→ 硬走进去 → 侵入

words.definition: adv. 上岸；在岸上；搁浅

examples.en: The sailors went ashore for a few hours of leave.
examples.zh: 水手们上岸休假几小时。

examples.en: The storm washed thousands of starfish ashore overnight.
examples.zh: 风暴一夜之间把成千上万只海星冲上了岸。

words.usage: go/come ashore 上岸；be washed ashore 被冲上岸；run ashore 搁浅；与 aboard 在船上、adrift 漂流同属 a- 前缀航海副词族，可串记
collocations: go ashore 上岸
be washed ashore 被冲上岸
run ashore 搁浅
words.mnemonic: a（到）+shore（岸）→ 到岸上去 → 上岸

words.definition: n. 船坞；码头；（法庭）被告席；v. 靠码头；扣除

examples.en: The cruise ship docked at Southampton early in the morning.
examples.zh: 邮轮一早停靠在南安普顿港。

examples.en: The firm docked his wages for repeated lateness.
examples.zh: 公司因他屡次迟到而扣了他的工资。

words.usage: 船入港 dock at/in；扣减 dock sb's pay/wages 扣薪；习语 in the dock 在被告席上、受审，亦喻受责难；dry dock 干船坞；dockyard n. 修船厂
collocations: in dry dock 在干船坞
dock one's pay 扣工资
dock at the port 靠港
words.mnemonic: dock 谐音「堵港」→ 堵在港里停靠 → 码头

words.definition: n. 方面；外观；样子；（语法）体

examples.en: The report examined every aspect of urban traffic congestion.
examples.zh: 报告审视了城市交通拥堵的方方面面。

examples.en: The dark stones give the old town a gloomy aspect.
examples.zh: 深色的石料使老城显得面貌阴郁。

words.usage: 最常用义方面：in this aspect 在这方面；an aspect of a problem 问题的一个方面；语法术语 the perfect aspect 完成体；勿与 perspective 混用

confusables.note: 方面，仅限 in this respect

collocations: every aspect of life 生活的方方面面
in this aspect 在这方面
a gloomy aspect 阴郁的外观
words.mnemonic: a+spect（看）→ 呈现出来给人看的一面 → 方面

words.definition: v. 闯入；侵扰；打扰

examples.en: A stranger intruded into the studio during the live broadcast.
examples.zh: 直播期间一名陌生男子闯进了演播室。

examples.en: I don't wish to intrude, but could I ask a quick question?
examples.zh: 不想打扰您，但能快速问一个问题吗？

words.usage: intrude on/upon sb 打扰、侵扰；intrude into 闯入；客气话 I don't mean to intrude 我无意打扰；派生 intrusion n. 侵扰
collocations: intrude on one's privacy 侵扰他人隐私
intrude into a meeting 闯入会议
I don't mean to intrude 我无意打扰
words.mnemonic: in 进+trude（推）→ 硬推进去 → 闯入

words.definition: n. 教义；学说；主义；信条

examples.en: The church's doctrine on marriage has evolved slowly over centuries.
examples.zh: 教会关于婚姻的教义历经数百年缓慢演变。

examples.en: The Monroe Doctrine shaped American foreign policy for generations.
examples.zh: 门罗主义影响了美国数代人的外交政策。

words.usage: religious doctrine 宗教教义；the doctrine of laissez-faire 自由放任学说为经济学常见；派生 indoctrinate v. 灌输思想（贬）
collocations: religious doctrine 宗教教义
political doctrine 政治学说
the doctrine of laissez-faire 自由放任学说
words.mnemonic: doct（教）+rine → 教导的内容 → 教义

words.definition: n. 女主人；女招待；女主持人；空姐

examples.en: The hostess greeted each guest warmly at the door.
examples.zh: 女主人在门口热情迎接每一位客人。

examples.en: An air hostess offered us drinks shortly after take-off.
examples.zh: 起飞后不久，一位空姐给我们送来了饮料。

words.usage: -ess 为表女性后缀，对应男性 host 男主人、主持人；air hostess 空姐为英式旧称，现多用 flight attendant；同类构词 actor→actress；host v. 主办、招待
collocations: air hostess 空中小姐
party hostess 宴会女主人
TV hostess 女主持人
words.mnemonic: host 主人+ess 表女性 → 女主人

words.definition: v. 哀悼；为…悲痛；感到痛惜

examples.en: The whole nation mourned the passing of the beloved writer.
examples.zh: 举国哀悼这位深受爱戴的作家的离世。

examples.en: Fans mourned the loss of the stadium that held so many memories.
examples.zh: 球迷们为这座承载无数记忆的球场被拆而惋惜。

words.usage: mourn for/over sb 为…哀悼；mourn the loss of sb 哀悼…的离世；派生 mourning n. 哀悼、丧服；mournful adj. 悲伤的
collocations: mourn the dead 哀悼死者
mourn for one's loss 为失去而悲恸
a mourning period 哀悼期
words.mnemonic: mourn 谐音「默哀嗯」→ 默哀 → 哀悼

words.definition: n. 直觉；直觉感知的事

examples.en: Her intuition told her that something was wrong with the deal.
examples.zh: 直觉告诉她这笔交易有问题。

examples.en: Great scientists often trust intuition before experiments confirm it.
examples.zh: 伟大的科学家常在实验证实之前先相信直觉。

words.usage: by intuition 凭直觉；与 instinct 相辨：intuition 靠潜意识判断，instinct 是天生本能；派生 intuitive adj. 直觉的
collocations: trust one's intuition 相信直觉
by pure intuition 纯凭直觉
intuition about sth 对…的直觉
words.mnemonic: in 内+tuit（看）+ion → 向内看 → 直觉

words.definition: n. 入侵；侵犯；（大批）涌入

examples.en: The invasion of privacy has become a defining issue of the digital age.
examples.zh: 侵犯隐私已成为数字时代的标志性议题。

examples.en: Reading his diary was an invasion of his personal space.
examples.zh: 偷看他的日记是对他私人空间的侵犯。

words.usage: an invasion of privacy 侵犯隐私为阅读高频；full-scale invasion 全面入侵；派生 invader n. 侵略者；invade v. 入侵
collocations: invasion of privacy 侵犯隐私
full-scale invasion 全面入侵
an invasion of tourists 游客大量涌入
words.mnemonic: invade 的名词：in+vade（走）→ 走进来 → 入侵

words.definition: n. 团；块；肿块；v. 把…归并；混为一谈

examples.en: She felt a lump in her breast and went to see a doctor at once.
examples.zh: 她摸到乳房有肿块，立刻去看了医生。

examples.en: The villagers lumped all city dwellers together as cold and rude.
examples.zh: 村民们把城里人一概说成冷漠粗鲁。

words.usage: a lump of coal/sugar 一块煤、糖；have a lump in one's throat 喉咙哽咽；lump sum 一次总付款为财经高频；lump A and B together 把…混为一谈
collocations: a lump in one's throat 哽咽
lump sum 一次性总付
lump A and B together 混为一谈
words.mnemonic: lump 谐音「撞扑」→ 撞出一块肿包 → 肿块

words.definition: n. （药的）一剂；剂量；一份（不快的事）；v. 给…服药

examples.en: The doctor doubled the daily dose to fight the stubborn infection.
examples.zh: 医生把每日剂量加倍，以对付顽固的感染。

examples.en: The market got a heavy dose of bad news last week.
examples.zh: 上周市场挨了一记沉重的坏消息。

words.usage: a dose of medicine 一剂药；daily dose 每日剂量；a dose of sth 引申为一份，多指不快经历；派生 dosage n. 规定剂量；overdose n. 用药过量
collocations: a dose of medicine 一剂药
daily dose 每日剂量
a dose of reality 现实的一课
words.mnemonic: dose 谐音「倒士」→ 倒出药水的一剂 → 剂量

words.definition: n. 运动；动作；提议；v. （打手势）示意

examples.en: The committee rejected the motion by a narrow margin.
examples.zh: 委员会以微弱差距否决了该动议。

examples.en: Newton's first law explains why objects resist changes in motion.
examples.zh: 牛顿第一定律解释了物体为何抵抗运动状态的改变。

words.usage: set sth in motion 使…启动，高频短语；go through the motions 敷衍应付；second a motion 附议；派生 motionless adj. 静止的
collocations: set sth in motion 启动某事
go through the motions 敷衍了事
reject a motion 否决议案
words.mnemonic: mot 动+ion → 动的状态 → 运动；会上「动」议

words.definition: adj. 无效的；作废的；无根据的；n. 病弱者

examples.en: The court declared the contract invalid because of hidden clauses.
examples.zh: 因存在隐瞒条款，法院宣布合同无效。

examples.en: Your passport becomes invalid after the expiry date.
examples.zh: 护照过期后即告失效。

words.usage: adj. 读 ɪnˈvælɪd：invalid argument/contract 无效论证、合同；n. 读 ˈɪnvəlɪd，指病弱者，为旧式用法；派生 invalidate v. 使无效；反义 valid 有效的
collocations: invalid contract 无效合同
an invalid passport 失效护照
invalid argument 站不住脚的论点
words.mnemonic: in 不+valid 有效 → 无效；重音前移变名词「病人」

words.definition: adj. 极宝贵的；无价的

examples.en: Her insider knowledge proved invaluable to the investigation.
examples.zh: 她的内幕知识对调查起到了极宝贵的作用。

examples.en: The museum's collection is an invaluable cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 博物馆的藏品是无价的文化遗产。

words.usage: 陷阱词：in- 在此表加强而非否定，invaluable 指价值高到无法估量，绝非没有价值；真正无价值的是 valueless、worthless；常用 invaluable to/for sb
collocations: invaluable to sb 对某人极宝贵
invaluable experience 宝贵经验
invaluable in doing sth 在做某事中极有用
words.mnemonic: in（加强）+valuable → 有价到无法估 → 无价的
